query:
insert or ignore into FailedTestRuns (
                agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            )
            with TestRunsWithFailedTestCase (
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            ) as (
                select
                    test_collect_nr,
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    test_run_date
                from ResolvedTestCaseStates
                where agg_collect_nr = $1
                and state != $2 and state != $3
            ), IndirectFailedTestRun (
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            ) as (
                select
                    d.collect_nr,
                    d.product_id,
                    d.test_run_name,
                    d.test_run_date
                from TestRunDescendants d, TestRunsWithFailedTestCase f
                where d.collect_nr = f.test_collect_nr
                and d.product_id = f.product_id
                and d.descendant_test_run_name = f.test_run_name
                and d.descendant_test_run_date = f.test_run_date
            )
            select
                $1 as agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            from TestRunsWithFailedTestCase

            union all

            select
                $1 as agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            from IndirectFailedTestRun
